```rust
use super::*;

#[test]
fn short() {
    const TEXT: &str = "abcd";
    let reference = ffi::CString::new(TEXT.to_string()).unwrap();

    let scs = SmallCStr::new(TEXT);

    assert_eq!(scs.len_with_nul(), TEXT.len() + 1);
    assert_eq!(scs.as_c_str(), reference.as_c_str());
    assert!(!scs.spilled());
}
```
